import hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('products/services/contracts-finder-small-data-qa/raw/tender-feed.json')
raw=p.read_bytes()
data=json.loads(raw)
pattern=re.compile(r'\b(?:data quality|data cleans(?:ing|e)|data cleaning|data reconciliation|data validation|spreadsheet|csv|data migration|data mapping|data audit)\b',re.I)
rows=[]
counts={'releases':0,'tenders':0,'matching_tenders':0}
releases=data.get('releases') if isinstance(data,dict) else None
if isinstance(releases,list):
 for release in releases:
  if not isinstance(release,dict):
   continue
  counts['releases']+=1
  tender=release.get('tender')
  if not isinstance(tender,dict):
   continue
  counts['tenders']+=1
  title=str(tender.get('title') or '')
  desc=str(tender.get('description') or '')
  lots=tender.get('lots') or []
  lot_text=' '.join(str(lot.get(field) or '') for lot in lots if isinstance(lot,dict) for field in ('title','description'))
  hits={field:sorted(set(m.lower() for m in pattern.findall(value))) for field,value in [('title',title),('description',desc),('lots',lot_text)]}
  if not any(hits.values()):
   continue
  counts['matching_tenders']+=1
  period=tender.get('tenderPeriod') or {}
  rows.append({'release_id':release.get('id'),'ocid':release.get('ocid'),'tender_id':tender.get('id'),'title':title[:300],'status':tender.get('status'),'deadline':period.get('endDate') if isinstance(period,dict) else None,'matches':hits})
rows.sort(key=lambda r:(not bool(r['matches']['title']),not bool(r['matches']['lots'])))
result={'source':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'feed_shape':'OCDS releases array' if isinstance(releases,list) else 'unrecognized feed shape','counts':counts,'candidates':rows[:8],'scope':'Keyword navigation in the saved response only. Verify current status, deadline, independently quotable scope and response conditions in the original buyer notice.'}
out=p.parent.parent/'director-tender-navigation.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact':str(out),'coverage':counts,'shape':result['feed_shape']},ensure_ascii=False))

description: The official Contracts Finder tender feed returned HTTP 200 and was saved. That gives us a new source to screen for a buyer requesting standalone data QA. The next step is to verify a current original notice and, if its scope and response conditions fit, turn one buyer acceptance criterion into an executed work sample and a private quote. Commercial feedback is available but five sources remain unclassified, so the absence of classified requests leaves demand unknown. Verified available funds and verified revenue are both zero. The procurement test can proceed with the available tools, while the staged SQLite release still requires independent approval of its exact digest.
